## §Coupling surfaces

**Grep patterns checked:**
- Volume path literals: `/app/data/lancedb`, `/app/data/duckdb`, `/app/data/bm25`
- BM25 directory template: `bm25/{domain}/main`, `challenge_hooks`
- Embedding model string: `all-MiniLM-L6-v2`, `sentence-transformers`
- Poll state string: `VECTOR_WRITE_QUEUED`
- Wire route: `/entries/indexed`, `/entries/failed`
- Compose image tag: `bishop/vector-writer:m0`
- File lock library name: `filelock` (spec prose only — not yet in code)
- DuckDB mode: `read_only=True` (query-api M7; vector-writer write mode)

**Surface 1** · confirmed
```
(per-domain BM25 path layout | contract surface: bishop_spec_0_6.md L565–570 + bishop_shared/constants.py BISHOP_VOLUME_MOUNTS bm25 suffix | main and challenge_hooks indices written to wrong dirs; query-api M7 cannot load | indexing-store-layout)
```

**Surface 2** · confirmed
```
(single domain file lock covers both BM25 indices | contract surface: bishop_spec_0_6.md L563–564 | interleaved locks deadlock or corrupt one index | bm25-write-locking)
```

**Surface 3** · confirmed
```
(VECTOR_WRITE_QUEUED poll omits content_raw | contract surface: services/state-worker/app/routers/poll.py omit_content_raw | vector-writer accidentally depends on missing field | vector-writer-poll)
```

**Surface 4** · confirmed
```
(DuckDB exclusive write vs query-api read | contract surface: bishop_spec_0_6.md §8.3 read_only=True for query-api | M7 query-api crashes on DuckDB lock if read_only omitted | duckdb-access-mode)
```

**Surface 5** · confirmed
```
(Compose vector-writer image tag m0 | contract surface: docker-compose.yml + tests/test_compose.py milestone_tags | CI compose gate fails after implementation | compose-tag)
```

**Surface 6** · suspected
```
(embedding text N1 join semantics | contract surface: bishop_spec_0_6.md L222–225 build_embed_text | semantic drift vs spec if join uses wrong separator | embedding-generation)
Disproven by: unit test on build_embed_text with fixture entry
```

**Surface 7** · suspected
```
(sentence-transformers model download in Docker build | contract surface: services/vector-writer/Dockerfile | image build timeout or CI flake without cache | embedding-generation)
Disproven by: successful docker build in T5/T6 with documented HF cache env optional
```
